title: The Frequency Experience app in mobile/ is typechecked, linted and tested on every PR that touches it
detail: Meta scan 2026-10-20 of the work merged since 2026-10-19 (LIVE-1121, LIVE-1122). mobile/ is excluded from the root tsc (tsconfig.json) and ignored by the root ESLint, and no workflow ran its own `pnpm check`, so a change to the app or to lib/contract (which it shares) could break it with every required check green. .github/workflows/mobile.yml runs mobile's typecheck, lint and test when a PR touches mobile/ or lib/contract/. It is not a required check and never builds an APK. Verified green locally 2026-10-20.

verify.note: Fails when no workflow runs mobile's own check on a PR that touches mobile/ or lib/contract/.
